nodes.name: bubble_assistant_text.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture representing a single Cursor chat bubble of type assistant-text, used to validate parsing of assistant text messages in the orgtrack-core sources module.

nodes.name: bubble_assistant_tool.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture representing a Cursor chat bubble of type assistant-tool, including nested toolFormerData (tool name, call id, params, result) used to validate tool-call bubble parsing.

nodes.name: bubble_user.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture representing a single Cursor chat bubble of type user, used to validate parsing of user messages in the orgtrack-core sources module.

nodes.name: composer.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture representing a Cursor Composer session header record, listing conversation timestamps and an ordered list of bubble id/type headers that reference the bubble_*.json fixtures.

nodes.name: warp_task.json
nodes.summary: Test fixture modeling a Warp terminal agent task with a full message sequence (user query, agent reasoning, shell tool call/result, file-diff edit, model info, and final assistant output), used to validate Warp history import parsing.
